def test_quoted_field_with_comma(tmp_path):
    path = write_csv(tmp_path, 'name,note\n"hello, world",x\n')
    total_rows, total_columns, first = summarize(path)
    assert total_rows == 1
    assert total_columns == 2
    assert first == ["hello, world", "x"]


def test_quoted_comma_with_space_before_quote(tmp_path):
    # Regression: a space between the delimiter and the opening quote used
    # to make the inner comma split the field into extra columns.
    path = write_csv(tmp_path, 'name,note\nBob, "Hello, world"\nAlice,fine\n')
    total_rows, total_columns, first = summarize(path)
    assert total_rows == 2
    assert total_columns == 2
    assert first == ["Bob", "Hello, world"]
